decisions.reason: The Android size requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording external streaming instead of bundling the video.
The How-To delivery requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY setting the video delivery method to external streaming.
Choosing external video streaming does not change the required iOS localization coverage or full-app localization behavior.
Choosing external video streaming does not change the required Android localization coverage or full-app localization behavior.
The video delivery choice does not change the iOS framework modernization or deprecated-API refactoring requirement.
External video streaming does not alter right-to-left layout behavior.
The video delivery strategy does not change the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
Streaming changes how the How-To video is delivered, not the measurement sequence conveyed by the content.
The video delivery strategy has no effect on iOS signing certificates or signing configuration.
The external-streaming decision does not change Android API, framework, or maintainability modernization requirements.
The How-To video's delivery method does not affect whether social media links resolve correctly.
The How-To video's delivery method does not change social media link localization requirements.
